title: Cross-Lingual Transfer Robustness to Lower-Resource Languages on Adversarial Datasets

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating zero-shot cross-lingual transfer performance of multilingual language models on Named Entity Recognition (NER) and section title prediction tasks using adversarial perturbations, specifically by substituting shared entities and context words between high-resource languages (HRLs) and low-resource languages (LRLs) with words unique to the low-resource language.
